title: Emanuel Ax with Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra
description: LSO kicks off its centennial season under the baton of Music Director Edward Polochick with Copland’s Fanfare for the Common Man and Tyler White’s A Fivescore Festival: 100 Measure for 100 Years. To amplify the celebration, LSO is joined for both fanfares by The Pride of All Nebraska: The Cornhusker Marching Band. LSO then pays homage to the program of its very first concert...

title: Whose Live Anyway?
description: The current cast members of the Emmy-nominated TV show Whose Line Is It Anyway? are proud to present their new improv tour: WHOSE LIVE ANYWAY?WHOSE LIVE ANYWAY? is 90 minutes of hilarious improvised comedy and song all based on audience suggestions. Cast members Ryan Stiles, Greg Proops, Jeff B. Davis, and Joel Murray will leave you gasping with the very witty scenes they invent...

title: Yächtley Crëw
description: Set sail for a night of smooth grooves and sun-soaked nostalgia with Yächtley Crëw, featuring spot-on renditions of hits by Hall & Oates, Michael McDonald, Steely Dan, and more; this high-energy band delivers “the nation’s #1 Yacht Rock band.” Grab your captain’s hat, it’s time to cruise!

title: Josh Johnson
description: Josh Johnson is an Emmy-nominated writer, stand-up comedian, actor, and NAACP award-winner. He was recently named as the newest correspondent on Comedy Central’s Emmy & Peabody Award-winning program “The Daily Show,” where he was previously a writer for the past six years and is also a former writer and performer on NBC’s “The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon.” In addition, he is Comedy Central’s “most watched comedian ever” with 40M+ views to date across their...

title: Metro Jazz Quintet: Broadway & Hollywood
description: BROADWAY & HOLLYWOOD Jazz classics from the Broadway stage & silver screen

title: Olivia Komahcheet
description: Olivia Komahcheet is a Comanche and Otoe-Missouria composer and sound artist whose work explores the intersection of sound, storytelling, and immersive experience. Her practice spans live performance, theatre, film, and experimental spaces, incorporating composition, spatial audio, sound design, and multimedia performance. Recent work includes sound design for theatre productions in Seattle and the Hamptons, developing original works at Imogen Heap’s Roundhouse...

title: Angel Stanislav Wang
description: Praised for his expressive depth, commanding technique, and artistic individuality, 23-year-old rising virtuoso Angel Stanislav Wang has quickly drawn international attention as a rare and compelling new pianist. His major accolades include winning First Prize at the International Rachmaninoff Piano Competition, becoming the youngest finalist at the 2025 Van Cliburn International Piano Competition, and at just age 23, he has already earned 35 international awards.

title: The Temptations
description: Ranked #1 in Billboard magazine’s most recent list of the “Greatest R&B/Hip-Hop Artists of All Time,” The Temptations are American music royalty and world-renowned superstars of entertainment. Led by founding member Otis Williams, this once-in-a-lifetime concert includes fan favorites, such as “My Girl,” “Just My Imagination (Running Away with Me),” “Ain’t Too Proud to Beg,” “Papa Was a Rollin’ Stone,” and more.

title: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis
description: Celebrate Wynton Marsalis’ final season as Artistic Director of Jazz at Lincoln Center and Music Director of the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra when the world-renowned ensemble returns to the Lied! Known for their incredible performances of the works of Duke Ellington, Count Basie, and original compositions, they are widely recognized as the world’s premier big band. Please join us for this special...

title: Matt Mathews
description: Matt Mathews is a comedian, singer/songwriter, and unapologetic trailblazer whose blend of raw honesty, quick wit, and Southern charm has made him one of comedy’s fastest-rising stars. Born and raised in Birmingham, Alabama, Mathews first captured attention during the pandemic with viral “farm chore” videos that showcased his humor and authenticity, quickly building a devoted following of more than 12...

title: Lumia
description: Step Into the Future with LUMIA: An Electrifying Theatrical Spectacle. Enter a dazzling world where the boundaries between technology and live performance vanish. LUMIA is a groundbreaking theatrical spectacle that blends award-winning acrobats, daring stunts, a pulse-pounding soundtrack, and cutting-edge visual effects into one unforgettable experience.

title: World Ballet Company: Swan Lake
description: The World’s MOST Iconic Ballet - With a LIVE Orchestra!

description: Presented by Lincoln Friends of Chamber Music

title: Revolutionary Ambition: America at 250
description: In recognition of the 250th anniversary of the United States, historian Nathaniel Philbrick will explore fascinating stories of the Revolutionary War. This event is part of the 2026-2027 E.N. Thompson Forum on World Issues . The lecture is free and open to the public, and livestreaming will be available. Details on tickets and livestream link will be available later this summer. ...

title: Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra: Violin Fantasy
description: LSO and guest conductor Andrew Grams are joined by concertmaster Anton Miller for Max Bruch’s energetic and virtuosic Scottish Fantasy. After intermission, LSO will perform either Edward Elgar’s Nimrod from his Enigma Variations OR Edvard Grieg’s In the Hall of the Mountain King – you decide with your vote! Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 8 closes this program.

title: Frederick Douglass! The Lion of Freedom
description: Experience the powerful story of Frederick Douglass in this gripping, one-man theatrical event performed by Darius Wallace. Through riveting storytelling and historic speeches, this performance brings Douglass’ journey from enslavement to national leadership vividly to life. Both inspiring and deeply moving, this acclaimed portrayal captures the voice, courage, and enduring legacy of one of America’s champions for freedom and equality.

title: Stars of Rent Adam Pascal & Anthony Rapp
description: “A revelatory show!” – The New York Times

title: One Vision of QUEEN featuring Marc Martel
description: When Hollywood needed someone to help bring Freddie Mercury’s voice to life in the Oscar-winning film "Bohemian Rhapsody," they turned to Marc Martel. Experience the music of QUEEN live in concert like never before, including iconic hits “Bohemian Rhapsody,” “We Will Rock You,” and “Somebody to Love” in this high-energy concert celebration.

title: Sisters Christmas Catechism: The Mystery of the Magi's Gold
description: It's "CSI: Bethlehem" in this holiday mystery extravaganza, from the author of Late Nite Catechism, as Sister takes on the mystery that has intrigued historians throughout the ages - whatever happened to the Magi's gold? ("We know that Mary used the frankincense and myrrh as a sort of potpourri - they were in a barn after all.") Retelling the story...

title: The Magic School Bus
description: Hop on the Magic School Bus for a ride through the solar system in this new musical adaptation based on the original book series published by Scholastic. When the class gets lost on the way to the planetarium, Ms. Frizzle saves the day by blasting into outer space for an epic interplanetary field trip!

title: A Magical Cirque Christmas
description: Get ready to be dazzled, enchanted, and filled with holiday cheer as you witness the incredible talents of world-class entertainers performing jaw-dropping acrobatics and amazing stunts, all set to your favorite holiday music. Embrace the holiday spirit with A Magical Cirque Christmas, an evening of nostalgia, charm, and awe-inspiring performances for all ages. Celebrate the magic of the season with the entire family!

title: The Swingles: Together for the Holidays
description: This holiday season, the British five-time GRAMMY®-winning a cappella group The Swingles presents a feast of musical comfort and joy, with classic carols and festive favorites that evoke fireside singalongs, icebound worlds, and blankets of snow. Wrap yourself in the warm vocal magic of The Swingles for a special night that proves there’s no place like the Lied Center for the holidays.

title: Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra: Deck the Halls
description: ‘Tis the season! LSO’s annual celebration returns with two performances for the whole family to enjoy! Join guest conductor Lucas Waldin and jazz/soul singer Rajdulari for a concert full of holly, jolly, and more. LSO will bring beloved holiday songs to life alongside Bell-issimo handbell choir, Lincoln Suzuki Studios , Standing Bear High School Vocal Music Program , and the adaptive dance...

title: Mamma Mia!
description: A mother. A daughter. 3 possible dads. And a trip down the aisle you’ll never forget!

title: Clue
description: A mansion. A murder. A mystery.

title: Metro Jazz Quintet: Hot Latin Nights
description: HOT LATIN NIGHTS The Music of Antonio Carlos Jobim, Dizzy Gillespie, Chick Corea and more!

title: Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra: Tchaikovsky's Fourth
description: LSO presents the newly commissioned My Brilliant Friend: Those Who Leave and Those Who Stay by Paola Prestini, celebrating female friendship as portrayed in Elena Ferrante’s Neapolitan novels. LSO principal horn Greg Helseth joins the orchestra to perform Richard Strauss’ lyrical and nostalgic Horn Concerto No. 2 . The program closes with Tchaikovsky’s electrifying Symphony No. 4 .

title: CARMEN.maquia Ballet Hispánico
description: Bizet's Carmen has seen countless interpretations over the past 150 years, but never one like this. Acclaimed choreographer Gustavo Ramírez Sansano brings this full-length ballet to the stage, inspired by tauromaquia – the art of bullfighting – breathing a modern life into this legendary character. Highly original and full of explosive movement that leaves you breathless, CARMEN.maquia is a bold reimagining of this tragic tale presented by Ballet Hispánico New York, the...

title: The Music of Billy Joel & Elton John starring Michael Cavanaugh
description: Handpicked by Billy Joel to play the leading role in Joel’s Broadway show featuring his greatest hits, Micheal Cavanaugh starred in over 1,200 performances of the Broadway show Movin’ Out earning him a Tony Award® nomination for his performance as Billy Joel. The Music of Billy Joel and Elton John features the greatest hits of these two great rock piano legends with songs, including: “Piano Man,” “Rocket Man,”” Bennie and the Jets,” “Movin’ Out,”” I’m...

title: Trombone Shorty & Orleans Avenue
description: Featured at almost every major music festival including Coachella, Bonnaroo, Lollapalooza, and Newport Jazz, Trombone Shorty regularly headlines the New Orleans Jazz Festival and makes his debut Lied Center performance this season! A powerhouse entertainer, he has toured with everyone from Maroon 5 to the Red Hot Chili Peppers and collaborated across genres with Pharrell, Bruno Mars, Mark Ronson, Foo Fighters, Zac Brown and Ringo Starr. This New Orleans ambassador has performed everywhere from the White House and GRAMMY® awards...

title: KODO
description: “Indeed, if there is such a thing as perfection in music, KODǑ comes as near to it as any group in the world.” – The Boston Globe

title: Orpheus Chamber Orchestra
description: GRAMMY® award-winning Orpheus Chamber Orchestra returns to the Lied with British virtuoso pianist Isata Kanneh-Mason for an evening of elegance and vitality. The program pairs classical favorites by Mozart and Haydn with selections from Handel’s Water Music Suite and a newly commissioned work by Katie Jenkins, showcasing Orpheus’ trademark conductor-less precision and collaborative spirit.

title: Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra: Jurassic Park in Concert
description: The action-packed adventure pits man against prehistoric predators in the ultimate battle for survival. Featuring visually stunning imagery and groundbreaking special effects, this epic film is sheer movie magic 65 million years in the making. Now audiences can experience Jurassic Park as never before: projected in HD with a full symphony orchestra performing John Williams’ iconic score live to picture....

title: The Three Little Pigs and Other Tales
description: Mermaid Theatre of Nova Scotia’s newest production, The Three Little Pigs and Other Tales, presents a fresh and engaging reimagining of three cherished children’s stories—Goldilocks and the Three Bears, The Three Billy Goats Gruff, and The Three Little Pigs. Filled with adventure, humor, and heroism, the story follows a brave raccoon and clever mouse who are on a journey to collect treasure. Along the way,...

title: Shucked
description: Maizy and Beau are getting hitched, when the corn that protects their small community starts to die. The town needs answers. But who will dare to venture beyond the borders of Cob County?

title: Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra: Rachmaninoff's Triumph
description: LSO welcomes the Lincoln Youth Symphony to the stage for a side-by-side premiere of a new work by Lincoln composer David von Kampen . LSO principal keyboardist Richard Fountain then performs Rachmaninoff’s brilliant and romantic Piano Concerto No. 2 . After intermission, LSO closes the concert with Johannes Brahms’ monumental Symphony No. 1 .

title: Girls Night: The Musical
description: GIRLS NIGHT: THE MUSICAL has been thrilling audiences and earning rave reviews since its sensational Off-Broadway debut. This touching and hilarious 'tell-it-like-it-is' musical takes audiences on a journey into the lives of a group of female friends. Audience members can’t help but laugh, cry and sing and dance in the aisles! Follow five friends as they visit their past, celebrate...

title: Twilight in Concert
description: Relive the magic of “Twilight” with Twilight In Concert! A stunning 12-piece ensemble will perform the unforgettable film score live, synchronized with the movie on a full-size cinema screen. Surrounded by the glow of over a thousand candles, this cinematic live-to-film concert experience will take you back to Forks like never before. Don’t miss this extraordinary night of music and romance.

title: Emmet Cohen
description: Emmet Cohen is widely regarded as a leading jazz pianist of his generation and makes his Lied Center debut this season! A virtuoso musician, producer, and bandleader, Cohen has released 12 albums and is the creative force behind Live From Emmet’s Place, a landmark series comprising over 140 two-hour livestream performances featuring hundreds of musicians spanning generations and reaching more than 100 million views worldwide. Cohen was named DownBeat Readers Poll Pianist of the Year (2025)...

title: Water For Elephants
description: “Many wonders await audiences in this gorgeously imaginative Broadway musical.” - The New York Times

title: Riverdance
description: Riverdance has captured the hearts of millions. The GRAMMY®  award-winning music and the infectious energy of its breathtaking performances has left audiences in awe and established Riverdance as a global cultural sensation. Celebrating its incredible 30th year milestone, Riverdance 30 – The New Generation rejuvenates the much-loved original show with new innovative choreography, costumes, and state of the art lighting, projection and motion graphics. And for the first time, Riverdance...

title: Piano Battle
description: It’s classical music like you’ve never seen it before! In Piano Battle, virtuoso pianists Andreas Kern and Paul Cibis go head-to-head in a thrilling, interactive competition where the audience decides the winner of each round. Blending dazzling technique with humor and showmanship, this high-energy performance transforms a traditional recital into an unforgettable musical showdown. Who performs it best? You decide!

title: Daniil Trifonov
description: Praised as “the most astounding pianist of our age” by London’s The Times, GRAMMY® Award-winning pianist Daniil Trifonov makes his Lied Center debut with a program showcasing extraordinary range. Handel’s Suite No. 5 in E Major (“The Harmonious Blacksmith”) opens the concert followed by Stravinsky’s sole piano sonata and Schubert’s beloved “Wanderer Fantasy,” a powerful musical depiction of a stranger’s search for meaning and happiness in a...

title: Metro Jazz Quintet: Legends of Jazz
description: LEGENDS OF JAZZ The music of Louis Armstrong, Duke Ellington, Charlie Parker, Stan Getz and more!

title: Magic Rocks! Illusionist Leon Etienne
description: “He is Amazing! I’m Speechless” – Jimmy Fallon, The Tonight Show

title: Mark Twain Tonight!
description: Emmy Award®-winning Actor Richard Thomas brings to life “the nation’s one true comic genius” (The New York Times) in Mark Twain Tonight! Join the millions who have cheered for the legendary one-man show, bursting with Twain’s “uproariously funny” and “pungently wise” (Time magazine) humor. Most recently seen on Broadway in “Our Town” and on tour (including at the Lied!) as Atticus Finch in “To Kill a Mockingbird,” and beloved to generations as John-Boy...

title: NoGravity Theatre
description: A jaw-dropping spectacle, Italy’s NoGravity plays with perspective, reflection, and distortion in its Lied Center premiere performance! On stage, the dancers move, fly in the air, and create unreal figures as if freed from gravitation – blending dance, illusion, and visual storytelling. NoGravity is celebrated for their works based on Dante’s “Divine Comedy” creating a dreamlike visual world. This innovative production transforms the stage into a dreamlike landscape of floating movement...

title: Lincoln's Symphony Orchestra: Beethoven's Ninth
description: LSO’s centennial celebration wouldn’t be complete without a performance of Beethoven’s masterpiece, Symphony No. 9 . Joining LSO are soloists Esther Heideman , Sylvia Leith , Bradley King , Edmund Milly , and the combined forces of the Abendmusik Chorus , Doane University Choir and Collegiate Chorale , Nebraska Wesleyan University Choir , and the Saint Paul UMC Chancel Choir . The program opens with Jake Runestad’s poignant choral piece, A Silence Haunts Me , with text based on Beethoven’s...

title: Hamilton
description: The unforgettable story of passion, unstoppable ambition, and the dawn of a new nation, seen by more than 28 million people around the world.
